hh_ethnologue_comment.comment:
E17/E18/E19/E20/E21/E22/E23/E24/E25/E26/E27/E28/E29 has a separate entry for Wergaia
[weg]. But Wergaia [weg] belongs to the Tjapwurrung branch of a large set of named varieties close enough to be the same language which may be called Western Victoria
(**hh:hw:Hercus:Victoria:1969**, **hh:hv:BlakeReid:Victorian**).

endangerment.comment: Wergaia (5565-weg) = Critically Endangered (20 percent certain, based on the evidence available) [n.a. n.d.](cldf:np:nd:195)
